summary.reading: Single-experience transfer does not exist for this knowledge, and the measurement is large enough to say so. 417 functions across 55 import-safe modules, all probed with one fixed witness pair, 7,522 cross-module pairs: observed agreement 0.6304 against a within-module-permuted null of 0.6253 +- 0.0087, a gap of +0.0051 (0.59 sigma). Knowing what a contrast did to one function therefore tells you almost nothing about another: the agreement that looks real is the label mix, since most functions return a value and never raise. This closes the line V26 opened. Entries are earned, they bind (V27), they cannot predict by shape (V28) and they do not transfer across modules (here).
